results.title: Burkina Faso - Wikipedia
results.snippet: Burkina Faso is a landlocked country in West Africa. It is bordered by Mali to the northwest, Niger to the northeast, Benin to the southeast, Togo and Ghana to the south, and Ivory Coast to the southwest. It covers an area of 274,223 km2.

results.snippet: The capital, Ouagadougou, lies in the country's center, approximately 500 miles (800 km) from the Atlantic Ocean. The eastern and central regions are the most densely settled, containing about half of Burkina Faso's total population.The capital of Burkina Faso is Ouagadougou.
